summary: On its own dates the Unit's appeal is outside the period the Tribunal can extend. Section 16 allows thirty days from communication and a further period not exceeding sixty days for sufficient cause. The Unit takes communication as 11 August 2025: thirty days ended on 10 September 2025 and the further sixty on 9 November 2025. It filed on 14 November 2025, and its own I.A. No. 1 pleads a delay of 65 days. If the email of 4 August 2025 at 18:42 was the communication, the delay is 72 days and the outer limit was 2 November 2025. The Unit has been closed since 5 August 2025, the day after the email. The delay application does not mention the order of 10 October 2025, and the record does not say when that order was communicated.
recommendation: On 2 December 2026, oppose condonation first: the pleaded delay exceeds the sixty days the proviso allows, on the Unit's own date. Use the closure from 5 August 2025 on the communication point; whether the email counts as communication is for counsel (FL-0006). Ask for the date on which the order of 10 October 2025 was communicated. Confirm that the s.18(2) bar on s.16 appellants does not reach the Samiti as an intervenor, and file no s.16 appeal for the Samiti (FL-0013).
